install.title: Install {{appName}}
install.why: On your home screen, full screen, and readable without a connection at the gig.

offline.banner: You're offline: showing saved data. Changes are turned off until the connection is back.

home.title: Welcome to {{appName}}
home.noBands: You're not in a band yet. Bands are joined through an invitation.

band.notFound: This band doesn't exist or you're not a member.
band.suspendedText: An administrator has suspended this band: its pages can't be opened for now. If you think it's a mistake, contact us.
band.comingSoon: Setlists and gigs are coming soon.

edit.title: Band details
edit.name: Band name
edit.nameForever: A band name is forever: it can't be changed.

logo.title: Logo
logo.none: No logo yet: the band's initials show instead.
logo.hint: PNG, WebP or JPEG. It shows as it is, with no background: choose a logo that reads on a dark background (a transparent one with light colours, or one with its own background). A large, sharp image prints better on setlists.

invite.title: Invite a musician
invite.description: They'll receive an email to join {{band}}. The link is valid for 48 hours.

instruments.title: My instruments
instruments.description: What you play in {{band}}. The first one is your main instrument.

songs.title: Repertoire
songs.empty: No songs yet. Add the first one!

unsavedNotes.title: Leave without saving the notes?
unsavedNotes.description: Your changes to the notes will be lost.

archive.hint: An archived song leaves the repertoire and stays in setlists and the journal. You can restore it.
archive.banner: This song is archived: it's out of the repertoire.

delete.title: Delete “{{title}}”?
delete.description: It will be gone for good. To take it out of the repertoire and keep it, archive it instead.

media.title: Links
media.empty: No links yet: videos, tracks, tabs, tutorials…
media.urlHint: A YouTube video, a Spotify or Deezer track, a tab…
media.urlInvalid: Type a web address starting with https://

search.title: Search on Deezer
search.description: Choose a track: its link and title fill the form in.

form.title: Title
form.invalidDuration: Type a duration as m:ss, like 3:45.
form.duplicateHint: Another version? Tell it apart in its title, like “{{title}} (acoustic)”.

unsaved.title: Close without saving the lyrics?
unsaved.description: Your changes to the lyrics will be lost.

search.title: Lyrics online
search.none: No lyrics found for this song.
search.description: Lyrics found online for this song: choose a version.
search.instrumental: LRCLIB lists this song as an instrumental.

lucky.nothing: Nothing found online: the song will be added as typed.
lucky.hint: Adding the song fills in its original duration, its style and its first link.
lucky.quota: Your band has used its 15 searches for today. Try again tomorrow, or add the song as typed with Save only.
lucky.linksFailed: The song is added, but its links couldn't be: add them from its page.

failed.deezer: Deezer had an error: some details may be missing.
failed.youtube: YouTube had an error: no videos this time.

documents.title: Documents
documents.empty: No documents yet: scores, chord grids, Guitar Pro or MuseScore files…
documents.formats: A photo (a chord grid on paper), a PDF, a Guitar Pro or MuseScore file.
documents.maxSize: 4 MB at most. Photos are made smaller first.
documents.removeDescription: Its file is deleted for everyone in the band.
documents.notSaved: This document isn't saved on this device yet.

login.title: Log in
login.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
login.invitationOnly: No account yet? {{appName}} is by invitation only: ask your band leader.

access.title: Private beta
access.description: {{appName}} isn't open to everyone yet. Enter the access code you were given: this device will remember it.
access.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
access.invited: Invited? The link in your invitation email lets you in without a code.

forgotPassword.title: Forgot your password?
forgotPassword.description: Enter your account's email: we'll send you a link to choose a new password.
forgotPassword.sent: If an account exists for {{email}}, a link has been sent to it. It's valid for 1 hour.

resetPassword.title: Choose a new password
resetPassword.description: Every device will be logged out, then you can log in with the new password.
resetPassword.done: Password changed. Log in with your new password.
resetPassword.invalidLink: This link isn't valid or has expired. Ask for a new one.

invite.title: Create your band
invite.intro: {{inviter}} invites you to create your band on {{appName}}.
invite.hasAccount: You already have a {{appName}} account with {{email}}. Log in to create your band.
invite.wrongAccount: This invitation is for {{email}}, but you're logged in as {{current}}.
invite.nicknameHint: Optional. Shown to your band instead of your name.
invite.name: Name

join.title: Join {{band}}
join.hasAccount: You already have a {{appName}} account with {{email}}. Log in to join {{band}}.

invite.bandNameHint: Choose carefully: a band name is forever.
invite.mainInstrumentHint: Optional. You can add others later from the lineup.

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: Your band mates see your nickname, or else your first and last name.

avatar.title: Avatar
avatar.description: Shown to your band mates. Your photo is cropped to a square.

changePassword.title: Change password
changePassword.description: Your other devices will be logged out.

impersonation.confirmText: You'll see their app as they do, read-only, for an hour at most. Stop from the banner at the top.
impersonation.notAllowed: You can't view the app as this user: not an admin, nor yourself.

invitations.title: Pending invitations
invitations.revokeDescription: The link sent to {{email}} will stop working.

dev.slowNetworkOn: Slow network: on (every API request waits 2 s)

errors.forbidden: You don't have access to this.
errors.internal_error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.network: Can't reach the server. Check your connection.
errors.already_invited: This email already has a pending invitation. Resend it instead.
errors.invitation_not_found: This invitation link isn't valid. Check that you copied it completely.
errors.invitation_expired: This invitation has expired. Ask for a new one.
errors.invitation_used: This invitation has already been used. Log in to continue.
errors.invitation_wrong_account: You're logged in with a different account from the one invited.
errors.band_name_taken: This band name is already taken.
errors.already_member: This person is already a member of the band.
errors.too_many_requests: Too many requests. Try again later.
errors.invalid_image: This file isn't a usable image. Choose a photo (JPEG, PNG, WebP…).
errors.image_too_large: This image is too large, even once reduced. Choose a smaller file.
errors.song_duplicate: This song is already in your repertoire.
errors.song_in_use: This song is used, in a setlist for example: archive it instead.
errors.too_many_links: This song already has as many links as it can.
errors.lyrics_unavailable: The lyrics service isn't answering right now. Try again later, or type them in.
errors.access_required: Enter the access code to continue.
errors.impersonation_read_only: Read-only while viewing the app as another user.
errors.deezer_unavailable: Deezer isn't answering right now. Try again later, or paste the link.
errors.document_invalid: Only photos (JPEG, PNG, WebP), PDFs, Guitar Pro and MuseScore files.
errors.document_too_large: This document is larger than 4 MB.
errors.too_many_documents: A song has at most 20 documents: remove one first.
errors.band_storage_full: Your band's documents have reached their storage limit: remove some first.
errors.band_not_disabled: Disable the band before deleting it.
errors.band_name_mismatch: The name typed isn't the band's.
errors.only_band_leader: This person is the only band leader of a band.

contact.title: Contact us
contact.sentAs: Sent to the {{appName}} team as {{name}} ({{email}}). We'll answer by email.
contact.subject: Subject
contact.bugContext: A bug report also sends the app's version, the page you came from, your browser and your language, to help us reproduce it.
